# Example: Pro consultation

## User request

“Ask the strongest available ChatGPT Pro model to challenge this migration plan, then verify its most important claims.”

## Route

- Mode: Chat with the explicitly requested or user-approved Pro model.
- Backend: native browser and thread bridge if available.
- Context: a redacted plan, not an entire repository.
- Gate: final response captured; three decision-critical claims checked against primary sources.

## Confirmation summary

“I am ready to send the redacted migration plan and this critique brief to the visible ChatGPT Pro conversation. No credentials, private messages, or unpublished source are included. Shall I send it now?”

If the local wait ends while the page is still generating, continue monitoring the same conversation. Do not send the prompt again.
